title: Call For Papers: Educational Data Mining 2027
about: EDM 2027, the Educational Data Mining conference in Adelaide, Australia, 18-23 July 2027. The JEDM Journal Track accepts de-identified submissions to the journal's 'EDM 2027 Journal Track' section, with cut-offs on 15 November 2026, 15 December 2026 and 15 January 2027.

upskill.name: Data Analytics
why: Field "Educational data mining" → Data Analytics Academy (e.g. A005.03 "Apply unsupervised learning techniques, including clustering and dimensionality reduction, to discover structure in data"); A005.03 does not reach course_min_score 6 for this record and the top-scoring courses (A010.06 content creation, A014.03 tool use) do not cover data mining, so the post links to the Academy page, not a specific course

card_alt: Card for "Call For Papers: Educational Data Mining 2027" from the International Educational Data Mining Society (EDM 2027), in Adelaide, Australia, deadline 15 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge at dusk in Sydney, not Adelaide.
